summary: I hold an M.Sc. in Computer Engineering (Artificial Intelligence & Robotics) from the Institute for Advanced Studies in Basic Sciences (IASBS), Zanjan, where my thesis used conditional GANs to strengthen ECG signals against adversarial attacks, supervised by Prof. Dr.-Ing. Mahdi Bohlouli. Before that, I completed a B.Sc. in Computer Engineering (Information Technology) at the University of Gonabad, working on deep learning for handwritten digit and facial emotion recognition. Since 2021 I've worked as a research engineer, teaching assistant, and project contributor across AI, medical signal processing, and IoT — including two years on the EU‑funded Erasmus+ IoTrain project.
